svg.title: Telemetry. 648 contributions in the last year across 35 repositories; 39 active days; longest run 6 days; on GitHub since 2020. A year of daily contributions drawn as an oscilloscope trace, and languages drawn as propellant tanks filled by how many repositories use them.
svg.text: height is logarithmic, so quiet days still show
PROPELLANT · LANGUAGES, BY REPOSITORIES THAT USE THEM
